description: This source file defines an interface called ThingSearchCommandAdapterProvider, which provides methods to retrieve adapters for search commands related to 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes import statements for Adapter and Signal classes, and a single method getSearchCommandAdapter().

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides access to a search command adapter for 'things', parameterized by a Signal type.

methods.name: getSearchCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns an Adapter for the generic Signal type specified by the type parameter M.
